opus_findings.problem: The new `covered()` fallback (lines 94-96, threshold `COVERED_WORDS` at line 31) builds `known_words` from the generated rules plus every SKILL.md and agent file. A line counts as kept when 70% of its 5+ letter words appear anywhere in that large pool. That hides real drops. Proof: run against today's `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, the "Gemini roles: ..." rule is classified `reworded`, yet it is in no generated source and no skill (only in the uncommitted `.claude/proposed-local.claude.md`). The same happened to a test line built from common skill words. `--fail-on-dropped` passes even though nothing carries the rule.
opus_findings.fix: Compare word coverage against a single target, not the whole pool: the closest generated line, or one skill sentence or paragraph (for example, the best `difflib` match above a looser ratio). Or report `covered` as its own class that `--fail-on-dropped` still fails on. Add a test where a rule made of common skill words is removed and must show as `dropped`.

opus_findings.problem: `moved_to_skill` marks the whole line `moved` once 50% of its sentences appear in a skill. The other half of a multi-sentence rule can be dropped without notice.
opus_findings.fix: Require every sentence (or every sentence with 6+ words) to be found in the skills or the generated rules. Or list the sentences that were not found in the report.

opus_findings.problem: The `words()` regex `[a-z][a-z/_.-]{4,}` keeps trailing `.` and `-`, so "review." and "review" count as different words. Results then depend on where a word sits in the sentence.
opus_findings.fix: Strip trailing `.-/` from each match, or use `\b[a-z][a-z_]{4,}\b`.

opus_findings.problem: The closing line always says "continue from .claude/handoff.md". The new save logic can write a root `HANDOFF.md` or a file in the temp folder instead, so this points the next session at the wrong file.

install.sh no longer writes CLAUDE.md, but there are two leftovers. (1) On machines not yet on nousfx_sync, the old "# Delegation policy" section it appended stays in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` forever, so the rules are still duplicated. (2) The guard's reason ("installing over it would fight the sync") now describes CLAUDE.md writes that no longer happen.
opus_findings.fix: Have install.sh print a one-time note (or a RUNBOOK step) to remove the old "# Delegation policy" section or run nousfx_sync. Reword the guard comment to give the real reason it still refuses.
